title: Viewing the Inline DLP Data Security Dashboard

blocks.text: The Inline DLP Data Security dashboard provides detailed information about data loss incidents from inline (web) sources in your organization.

blocks.item: This widget shows the total number of incidents involving Inline DLP policy violations across your organization.
This bar chart shows the top types of sensitive inline DLP data in your organization.
Sensitive Files in Top 10 ML Categories

This Sankey diagram shows information about files within various machine learning categories within your organization. Hover over a line in the chart to see the percentage that the files in the category represents as it relates to the total number of files.
Click View All Data Discovery to open the Data Discovery Report, filtered for machine learning categories.
